agent_priors_used: PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): tool-use agents frequently fail multi-step tasks through observation salience and action-space encoding rather than raw model capacity, so varying the observation representation is a legitimate capability probe.

PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): reuse/caching systems must be benchmarked against strong native caching and retrieval baselines before any moat or cost advantage claim; beating a deliberately non-executing baseline is meaningless.

PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a single degenerate instrumentation helper can manufacture false sensitivity (or false insensitivity), and repairing it once is cheaper than re-discovering the same invalidity across multiple lanes.
PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): long-horizon agents accumulate error, so verification cost, abstention and stale-replay false-accept rates belong in any net-cost comparison, not only raw action counts.
PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): a lane repeatedly measuring one claim is a diagnostic of diminishing marginal information only; concentration is not itself evidence of waste.

PRIOR (not SPIDER evidence): representation/work-compression hypotheses (multi-resolution navigation plus decomposable macros versus flat cache) are testable engineering hypotheses about cost per verified safe success, not established Web laws.

allocation.question: Resume the pre-freeze experiment: on the certified non-ceiling credential-free bank (SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V3) with the shipped byte-identical parameterized carrier, does the founding multi-scale representation/work-compression hypothesis hold -- i.e. does parameterized inheritance with decomposable/multi-resolution structure achieve strictly lower counter-cost (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) per VERIFIED SAFE success than strong internal baselines (flat exact-state cache, nearest-neighbour/retrieval, compiled procedural lookup, and the empty-registry inheritance ablation) at matched correctness, and does the advantage grow with controlled residual novelty rather than full task length -- with NO LLM agent required, as a bounded prerequisite/derisk for the gated four-arm flagship rather than the flagship itself?
allocation.rationale: This pre-freeze experiment targets the same claim and remains strategically correct, so CONTINUE with USE. A cognitive reset was performed (tunnel flag true; C-PARAM-INHERIT 9/10 recent): a fresh product lane would not run a tenth carrier-safety hardening but would test whether the inheritance architecture actually beats flat caching/retrieval on cost -- which is exactly this no-LLM ablation. B1 and B2 are discharged, so the treatment (shipped carrier) and the non-ceiling comparators (flat cache / NN / procedural lookup / empty-registry) are now distinguishable; B3 is missing but this design needs no LLM and is explicitly a derisk, so it does NOT fund the gated flagship (which remains barred until B3 is resolved and is not allocated to any lane this cycle). Decision counterfactual: if inheritance+multi-scale strictly lowers cost per verified safe success and the margin grows with residual novelty, the core architecture is supported and the flagship is justified once B3 is closed; if flat cache/nearest-neighbour ties or wins, the architecture claim is in doubt and the flagship should not be funded regardless of agent capability. Strongest baselines: flat exact-state cache, nearest-neighbour/retrieval, compiled procedural lookup and the empty-registry ablation under identical counters -- a deliberately non-executing baseline would be meaningless. Budget/stopping: one bounded no-LLM batch; hard stop if deterministic counters force treatment-cold ties (the prior C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY packet already observed treatment ties cold on deterministic counters and the pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate was unsatisfiable on the mandatory-discovery class, so the bank must be the certified V3 construction or the experiment does not run).

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Reading `effective_event_by_claim` rather than raw chronology: 458 canonical packets, 60 recent audits (PASS 38, REVISE 8, MEASUREMENT_INVALID 12, FAIL 2; revise-or-invalid 0.333). Two of the three product blockers from the 10-Oct audit are now discharged by accepted evidence: B1 (a byte-identical parameterized carrier is shipped and independently audited, with a known-negative refusal) and B2 (a credential-free, memory-robust, non-ceiling task bank SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V3 is certified). B3 (a capable external same-model agent endpoint/runtime) is NOT satisfied: the credential-free local 3B-14B class and every provisionable hosted path have failed the minimal multi-step Web-agent bar. Therefore the gated four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON flagship benchmark remains barred, and this pulse deliberately funds only (a) completion of already-frozen transactions and (b) bounded, no-LLM, decision-changing prerequisites plus the one B3 blocker probe. The six lanes are all live: Frontier, Graph, Intel and Runtime hold FROZEN transactions that must complete under their frozen design; Physics and Product hold PREFREEZE work that is resumed because each still targets the most decision-relevant open question on its claim. The portfolio currently separates the central cost question into orthogonal slices -- representation/compression economics (Product), deep-path persistence economics (Frontier), localized-repair economics (Runtime), semantic addressing generalization (Graph), capability blocker (Intel) and access-barrier generalization (Physics) -- with no lane duplicating another. Nothing here establishes a validated external-agent product, and no PASS is treated as positive evidence. Cross-cutting risk: audit friction remains ~33%, largely instrumentation/design rather than falsification, so Runtime/Product repairs of shared validity blockers are prioritized over another round of near-duplicate invalid runs. Local-attractor tunnel flags on Intel, Physics, Product and Runtime are treated as diagnostic only; each flagged lane's current design is materially orthogonal to its recent dominant claim (Intel: observation-representation probe rather than another endpoint ladder; Physics: source-vantage factor rather than the answered window axis; Product: representation economics rather than carrier safety hardening; Runtime: delta-repair instrument repair rather than another C-MEAS-VALID substrate certificate).
